# Google Chrome Browser Plugin: features

Run with `invoke_plugin_feature(feature_id, plugin_id="chrome", args={...})`. Prefer these over clicking: they use hotkeys and menus the plugin already knows.

| Feature | What it does | Hotkey | Menu | Pane | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `browser.navigate` | Focuses address bar, enters URL, and loads web page | ctrl+l |  | address_bar | `url`, `new_tab` |
| `browser.new_tab` | Opens a new empty browser tab | ctrl+t |  | tab_strip |  |
| `browser.close_tab` | Closes the currently active browser tab | ctrl+w |  | tab_strip |  |
| `browser.switch_tab` | Switches to a tab by index (1..9) or direction ('next' / 'prev') |  |  | tab_strip | `tab_index`, `direction` |
| `browser.reload` | Reloads the current webpage with optional cache bypass | ctrl+r |  |  | `hard` |
| `browser.zoom_in` | Increases webpage zoom level | ctrl+plus |  |  |  |
| `browser.zoom_out` | Decreases webpage zoom level | ctrl+minus |  |  |  |
| `browser.zoom_reset` | Resets webpage zoom to default 100% | ctrl+0 |  |  |  |
| `browser.find_in_page` | Opens Chrome in-page search bar and optionally searches text | ctrl+f |  |  | `query` |
| `browser.devtools` | Toggles Chrome Developer Tools panel | ctrl+shift+i |  |  |  |
| `browser.scroll_content` | Positions pointer in web content viewport and scrolls smoothly |  |  | content_area | `direction`, `amount` |
| `browser.dismiss_dialog` | Dismisses active modal dialogs, cookie banners, or permission requests | escape |  |  |  |
| `browser.gemini_query` | Submits prompt to active Gemini Web app session and monitors streaming generation |  |  | content_area | `prompt`, `press_enter` |

Named panes for `capture_pane(pane_name)`: `address_bar`, `bookmark_bar`, `content_area`, `devtools_dock`, `tab_strip`.
